method: Auxiliary CSS text inventory of loaded styles plus library source CSS (may include unused/shared bundle definitions). Includes fallback literals, generated declarations and chart/host exceptions; not scoped element coverage or a defect count. Only individually verified in-scope candidates enter the report; Studio page itself is excluded.

colorLiteralLines.text: @supports ((-webkit-hyphens: none) and (not (margin-trim: inline))) or ((-moz-orient: inline) and (not (color:rgb(from red r g b)))) {

.delivery-filter-toggle { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; width:100%; min-height:24px; padding:0; border:0; background:transparent; box-shadow:none; color:#88888f; cursor:pointer; }

.search-sample-dag { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid var(--color-border-default); background:#11151a; padding:8px 12px; color:var(--color-text-muted); font-size:12px; }
.search-sample-dag input { width:128px; background:transparent; color:#e2e8f0; outline:none; border:0; font:inherit; }
.search-sample-sidebar { display:flex; align-items:center; width:100%; height:36px; padding:0 4px; border-radius:6px; background:#ffffff06; color:#94a3b8; }
.search-sample-sidebar button { display:grid; place-items:center; width:28px; height:28px; flex-shrink:0; padding:0; border:0; border-radius:6px; background:transparent; color:#94a3b8; }
.search-sample-sidebar input { flex:1; width:100%; height:100%; padding:0 6px; border:0; background:transparent; color:#e2e8f0; outline:none; font-size:13px; }

.wsr-bi .wsr-search-surface { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; min-height:40px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid #ffffff0f; border-radius:12px; background:#29292c; color:#a4a4ab; box-shadow:0 4px 12px #00000005,0 2px 8px #0000000a; transition:background-color 160ms ease,box-shadow 160ms ease,color 160ms ease; cursor:text; }

.wsr-bi .wsr-search-surface > input:is(:focus,:focus-visible) { appearance:none; flex:1; min-width:0; width:100%; height:34px; padding:0; border:0; border-radius:0; outline:none; box-shadow:none; background:transparent; color:#f4f4f5; font:inherit; font-size:14px; line-height:20px; caret-color:#f4f4f5; }

.wsr-bi .wsr-expandable-search-title { position:absolute; inset:0; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:0 12px; border-radius:8px; background:#ffffff06; color:#a4a4ab; font-size:11px; font-weight:600; transition:opacity var(--search-motion),transform var(--search-motion); }

.wsr-bi .wsr-expandable-search-trigger { display:grid; place-items:center; width:28px; height:28px; padding:0; flex-shrink:0; border:0; outline:none; box-shadow:none; background:transparent; color:#a4a4ab; cursor:pointer; }

.wsr-bi[data-crystra-theme=dark] .wsr-field[data-appearance=embedded] select::picker-icon { content:""; width:7px; height:7px; margin-inline-start:auto; margin-inline-end:2px; flex-shrink:0; align-self:center; border-right:1.5px solid currentColor; border-bottom:1.5px solid currentColor; color:#a4a4ab; transform:translateY(-2px) rotate(45deg); transition:transform 220ms ease,color 160ms ease; }

.expression-history-body .expression-history > div > div > span { display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; min-width:0; font-size:10px; color:#151a22; border-right:1px solid #202020; }
.structured-table th,.structured-table td { border-bottom:1px solid #ffffff15; padding:5px 4px; text-align:right; font-weight:400; }
.structured-bar-numeric-axis > div { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; border-top:1px solid #ffffff20; padding-top:4px; }
